facility_description.value: Two single-story steel-framed cardiac catheterization lab additions on the north side of the main hospital complex, Building 500, Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center. Includes east and west cath labs.
facility_description.quote: The Cardiac Cath labs included in the project are comprised of two independent building additions located near the north side of the main hospital complex. These additions are single story, steel framed structures currently housing HVAC equipment above the ceiling level / below the roof plane, and also placed on the roof above.

corroboration.claim: Two independent building additions, north side of main hospital complex, single story, steel framed

hvac_scope_description.value: Complete replacement of existing HVAC (ceiling-mounted AHUs and ductless split systems) in Cardiac Catheterization Lab. Base bid: VRF/VRV system (Daikin) for admin/storage/control room; two roof-mounted AHUs (N+1 redundancy) for OR suites; 100% OA exhaust fan configuration; controls integrated with Metasys DDC system. Bid deduct: retain existing ceiling-mounted unit for offices/control room; three new roof-mounted AHUs for OR suites.
hvac_scope_description.quote: The base bid includes the entire removal of the HVAC systems for the Cath Lab. The existing HVAC systems include: Ceiling-mounted air handling units and ductless split system units serving the entire suite.
